newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Painewebber cuts Anadarko Q2.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Painewebber cuts Anadarko Q2.

text.p: PaineWebber said that it had cut its second quarter earnings estimate for Anadarko Petroleum Corp to $0.21 per share from $0.30, after the company said it would realize lower than expected prices and lower than projected volumes in the Gulf of Mexico.

Analyst Ron Barone said that he is maintaining his full year EPS forecast of $1.63 and that he continues to rate the stock attractive on the basis of cashflow and net asset valuations, as well as its aggressive exploration program and production and reserve growth prospects.
"We view any weakness associated with earnings estimate reductions as a buying opportunity," Barone said.
Anadarko stock was off 13/16 at 61-5/16 after the earnings downgrade. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
